newsitem.title: USA: Zeigler Coal unit signs to have plant built.
newsitem.headline: Zeigler Coal unit signs to have plant built.

text.p: Zeigler Coal Holding Co said Monday a new company formed by two of its subsidiaries has signed contracts for Mitsubishi Corp's Mitsubishi International Corp to build a $460 million liquids from coal plant in Wyoming.
The contract was signed by NuCoal LLC, a newly formed unit of ENCOAL Corp and Americoal Development Co, Zeigler said.

Completion of the facility is subject to certain conditions including obtaining construction and permanent financing and all necessary permits, Zeigler said. If Zeigler does not find partners and financing by September, the contracts are void, a spokeswoman for the coal company said.
The contracts call for the engineering, procurement and construction of a three-module liquids from coal processing facility capable of processing six million tons of coal feedstock per year.
Zeigler shares were unchanged at 21-5/8 Monday.
